lucky.en: It was lucky for you that you found it.

luggage.en: Sir, can we quickly inspect your luggage please?
luggage.zh: 先生，我们可以检查一下您的行李吗？

lose.en: The best way to lose weight is to eat less and exercise more.
lose.zh: 最好的减肥方法就是少吃多运动。

liquid.en: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
liquid.zh: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。

lay.en: A beautiful lake lay just beyond the forest.
lay.zh: 森林外有一个美丽的湖泊。

lead.en: Driving on a slippery road can lead to a car wreck.
lead.zh: 在光滑的路上开车会导致车祸。

later.en: Tom is going to be coming here later this afternoon.
later.zh: 汤姆今天下午会来这里。

lid.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.

lock.en: If I lost my key, I wouldn't be able to lock the door.
lock.zh: 如果我弄丢了我的钥匙，我就无法锁门了。

learned.en: It was an advantage having learned Chinese while I was in school.
learned.zh: 在学校时我学了中文是个优势。

lion.en: If the lion is the king of beasts, the eagle is the king of birds.
lion.zh: 狮子是兽类之王的话，鹰就是鸟类之王。

luck.en: A little bit of luck sometimes leads to an unexpected success.
luck.zh: 一点点的运气有时会导致意想不到的成功。

lady.en: We moved our bags to make room for the elderly lady to sit down.
lady.zh: 我们移走了行李腾出空间让老太太可以坐下。

lift.en: She tried to lift the box, but found it impossible to do.
lift.zh: 她试了试举起箱子，但举不起来。

line.en: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
line.zh: 线条艺术强调形式和轮廓，而不是颜色、阴影和纹理。

list.en: She went over the list to see if her name was there.
list.zh: 她走过去看看她的名字是否在清单上。

lamp.en: He hung a lamp from the ceiling.
lamp.zh: 他把一盏灯挂在了天花板上。

learning.en: I know that you are learning French at school.
learning.zh: 我知道你在学校学法语。

leader.en: The leader governed his country for more than 50 years.
leader.zh: 这位领导人统治了他的国家五十年。

location.en: A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
location.zh: 那个地点的书店无法赚足够的钱生存下去。

lonely.en: When I first came back to Boston, I was really lonely.
lonely.zh: 当我第一次回波士顿时，我真是孤独。

lawyer.en: He is reputed the best lawyer in this city.
lawyer.zh: 他被认为是这座城市里最好的律师。

law.en: Everybody is supposed to know the law, but few people really do.
law.zh: 每一个人都应该知法懂法，但是真正能做到的人却很少。

lung.en: That man died of lung cancer a week ago.
lung.zh: 那个男人在一周前死于肺癌。

lower.en: Owing to its landmass, the Antarctic has an air temperature lower than that of the Arctic.
lower.zh: 南极因为有大陆，所以气温低于北极。

living.en: I think that our living together has influenced your habits.
living.zh: 我觉得我和你一起住影响了你生活的方式。

loud.en: The radio is too loud. Can't you turn it down a little?
loud.zh: 收音机太响了。你不能把音量调低一点吗？

lately.en: I've been coming to work one train earlier lately.
lately.zh: 我已经搭了最近比较早一点的火车来上班。

logic.en: Do you not understand basic logic?

ladder.en: Is this ladder strong enough to bear my weight?
ladder.zh: 这个梯子是否足够坚固以承受我的重量？

logical.en: The most logical place to keep your shoes is near the door.
logical.zh: 最合逻辑的放鞋处是门口附近。

lightning.en: The taller the tree, the more likely it is to be struck by lightning.

likely.en: The taller the tree, the more likely it is to be struck by lightning.

less.en: We have less than five minutes to evacuate the whole building.
less.zh: 我们有不到五分钟来疏散整栋楼的人。

latin.en: Many English words are derived from Latin.
latin.zh: 许多英文单字源自于拉丁文。

laundry.en: I don't like to use liquid laundry detergent.

loan.en: I told Tom I'd be willing to loan him some money.
loan.zh: 我告诉汤姆我愿意借给他一些钱。

loss.en: The company suffered a loss of one billion yen last year.
loss.zh: 那家公司去年亏损了10亿日元。

limit.en: My patience is nearing its limit.

lemon.en: Bring me a glass of tea with lemon.

leather.en: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
leather.zh: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。

leadership.zh: 汤姆天生具有领导能力。

laughter.en: A day without laughter is a day wasted.
laughter.zh: 没有笑声的一天肯定是最为虚度的一天。

least.en: When she was in Los Angeles, she had at least six different jobs.
least.zh: 当她在洛杉矶的时候, 她至少有六份工作。

lighter.en: Women eat lighter meals when they're eating with a guy.
lighter.zh: 当女性跟一个男人吃饭时，女性会吃得比较少。

license.en: My mother has a driver's license, but she doesn't drive a car.
license.zh: 我母亲有驾照，但是她不开车。

lighten.en: It was just a joke. Lighten up!

liar.en: A liar needs to have a good memory.
liar.zh: 说谎的人需要很好的记忆力。

lining.en: Every cloud has a silver lining.

loaf.en: I just remembered that I was supposed to buy a loaf of bread.
loaf.zh: 我才想起来我之前该买个面包。

lens.en: I'm looking for my contact lens.

lecture.en: It is not necessary for us to attend this lecture.
lecture.zh: 我们没有必要出席这个讲座。

layout.zh: 我改了一下我网站的版面设计。

landing.en: In a few minutes we'll be landing at New Tokyo International Airport.
landing.zh: 我们将于几分钟内降落在新东京国际机场。

likelihood.en: In all likelihood, this means war.

landscape.en: The landscape is unfamiliar to me.

level.en: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.
level.zh: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。

lazy.en: The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy brown dog.
lazy.zh: 身手矫健的棕狐狸跃过懒洋洋的棕狗。

leak.en: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
leak.zh: 这场爆炸有可能是瓦斯外泄引起的。

length.en: The length of this ship is 30 meters.

lack.en: The firm went under due to lack of capital.
lack.zh: 公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。

locate.en: I can't locate the source of the problem.
locate.zh: 我无法找到问题的根源。

leisure.en: She spends her leisure time making dolls.
leisure.zh: 她利用空闲时间做布娃娃。

lab.en: The air conditioner in the lab is broken.

label.en: Tom picked up the jar and read the label.

longing.en: We are all longing for peace in the world.

leading.en: Car accidents are the leading cause of death for teenagers in the United States.
leading.zh: 交通事故是美国青少年死亡的主要原因。

liquor.en: Lips that touch liquor shall not touch mine.
liquor.zh: 碰过酒的嘴唇就别想碰我的唇。

lover.en: She was seen at a restaurant with her lover.
lover.zh: 有人看见他和情人在饭店吃饭。

lawn.en: I didn't charge Tom anything to mow his lawn.
lawn.zh: 我修剪汤姆的草坪，没有向他收取任何费用。

landlord.en: The landlord says he wants to raise the rent.

literal.en: He explained the literal meaning of the sentences.
literal.zh: 他解释了句子的字面意思。

legal.en: The legal system in America is the world's finest.
legal.zh: 美国的司法制度是世界上最好的。

laboratory.en: This laboratory is equipped with the latest computers.
laboratory.zh: 这个实验室配备了最新的计算机。

lobby.en: Meet me at the lobby of the Imperial Hotel at 6:30 p.m.
lobby.zh: 下午六点半到帝国酒店的大堂找我。

largely.en: The audience was largely made up of very young children.
largely.zh: 大部分观众是年幼的儿童。

lifetime.en: An opportunity like this only comes along once in a lifetime.
lifetime.zh: 一辈子只会出现一次像这样的机会。

log.en: In Canada, there are many areas where it is illegal to log trees.
log.zh: 在加拿大有很多区域砍伐树木是非法的。

laser.en: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
laser.zh: 激光打印机一般比喷墨打印机用起来更省钱。

lip.en: Throughout the five years of painful cancer treatments, he managed to keep a stiff upper lip.
lip.zh: 这五年痛苦的癌症治疗他终于坚持下来了。
